title: Tencent Launches the Public Welfare Version of WorkBuddy, 15 Intelligent Agents Collaborate to Cover 42 Public Welfare Scenarios
excerpt: On September 2, on the occasion of the 12th "Jiujiu Public Welfare" event, WorkBuddy's public welfare edition - the Tencent Public Welfare Smart Assistant "Publ
content_html:
On September 2, on the occasion of the 12th "Jiujiu Public Welfare" event, WorkBuddy's public welfare edition - the Tencent Public Welfare Smart Assistant "Public Welfare Buddy" - was officially launched, becoming the first infrastructure-level AI solution for the public welfare industry built by Tencent SSV based on the WorkBuddy Agent foundation. Institutional users can experience it through the "Discover Applications" entry point.

For repetitive tasks such as activity reports, progress reports, invoices, and filing, Public Welfare Buddy has integrated 11 scenario capsules and 42 scenario capabilities, supported by 15 intelligent agents, covering needs such as funding applications, invoice processing, due diligence analysis, and interpretation of charity laws.

It is already connected with the Tencent Public Welfare Institution Service Platform, capable of generating daily, weekly, and monthly reports, analyzing donor data, processing invoices, and updating documents and filings. During the "Jiujiu Public Welfare" period, it can also generate a "Jiujiu Love Battle Report" with one click. General capabilities do not rely on platform data and have already launched hundreds of public welfare-specific skills and expert teams; AI-generated content must be reviewed by humans before being published.
